channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday competitions 2026 (Australia)
channel.description: Competitions and giveaways open to Australian residents that are tied to Black Friday (Friday 27 November 2026) and Cyber Monday (30 November), each checked on the promoter's own page. Many close within days of Black Friday, so check the closing date on each one. Only entries we have confirmed as open are listed.

item.title: Skinstitut Win a Year's Supply of Skincare ($2,000) – Skinstitut
item.description: Prize: A year's supply of Skinstitut products valued at AUD $2,000. Deadline: November 7, 2026. Submit the online entry form on the competition landing page (social likes/comments do not count). Free, Australian residents 16+. 21 Oct 9am – 7 Nov 2026 11:59pm AEDT, draw 9 Nov

item.title: EOS Footwear Black Friday Wardrobe Win: $1,000 voucher – EOS Footwear (Urban Shoemakers Pty Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One $1,000 EOS Footwear voucher. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter your details in the form on the page. Australian residents 18+. Closes 23:59 AEDT on 29 November 2026; winner drawn by 30 November

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (AU) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV A$1,299) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. Australian residents 18+. Closes 1 December 2026, 3:59 PM AEDT
